summary: Use the accessible folder hierarchy with persisted collapse state and arrangement-backed drag and drop; place nested-row time in the subtitle to preserve title width. Flat and tree row accessible names reference their visible title and subtitle in DOM order, while status and reported unread facts stay in the description; unreported unread is omitted. Tree row bindings survive label and status updates even though React Aria owns the row props.

compatibility.detail: No storage, protocol or wire-format change.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
